correctness.rationale: The product W-valued polarized bilinear forms gives J^3=0 and J²=Ann(J)=W by nonsingularity. For R=f⊗a, the RB equation reduces to f(x)f(y)a²=(f(x)f(ay)+f(y)f(ax))a. If image lies in W, all q^6-1 nonzero f work on each of q+1 image lines. Otherwise a²=0 and f(aJ)=0; smoothness forces aJ=W at every isotropic projective line, giving q²(q^4-1) maps per C point. The elliptic model is the standard intersection of X1²=X0X3 and X2²=X1X3+c2X0X3+c4X0X1+c6X0², smooth even at infinity. Independent F3 arithmetic found |C(F3)|=4, total 5792 rank-one maps, and 800 direct checks of the defining RB identity on basis pairs. These are finite corroborations of the general proof.
